[SWS_FrTrcv_00311]
⌈The
function
FrTrcv_CheckWakeupByTransceiver()
shall
call
the
API
service
EcuM_SetWakeupEvent
with
the
parameter
value
ECUM_WKSOURCE_FRTRCV_FR of EcuM_WakeupSourceType only in case a
valid wakeup originated from the transceiver identified by FrTrcv_TrcvIdx. Thus, shared
interrupts are easily de-multiplexed: Drivers just return doing nothing if they did not
trigger the interrupt.⌋
